content.text: Hello, I'm Sam.
content.translation: 你好，我是 Sam。

content.text: Hi, I'm Amy.
content.translation: 嗨，我是 Amy。

content.text: Good morning, boys and girls.
content.translation: 早上好，孩子们。

content.text: Good morning, Ms Smart.
content.translation: 早上好，Smart 老师。

content.text: Good morning, Ms Smart.
content.translation: 早上好，Smart 老师。

content.text: Good morning, Daming. How are you?
content.translation: 早上好，大明。你好吗？

content.text: I'm fine, thank you.
content.translation: 我很好，谢谢。

content.text: Good. How are you, Lingling?
content.translation: 好的。玲玲，你好吗？

content.text: What's your name?
content.translation: 你叫什么名字？

content.text: My name's Amy.
content.translation: 我叫 Amy。

content.text: Hi, Amy! Are you a student?
content.translation: 嗨，Amy！你是学生吗？

content.text: Stand up, please.
content.translation: 请起立。

content.text: OK!
content.translation: 好的！

content.text: Point to the window, please.
content.translation: 请指向窗户。

content.text: What colour is it?
content.translation: 它是什么颜色？

content.text: It's red.
content.translation: 它是红色的。

content.text: Do you like candy?
content.translation: 你喜欢糖果吗？

content.text: Yes, I do.
content.translation: 是的，我喜欢。

Module 6.unit: Unit 1 I have got a cat.

content.text: I've got a cat.
content.translation: 我有一只猫。

content.text: Have you got a dog?
content.translation: 你有一只狗吗？

content.text: Happy birthday, Sam!
content.translation: 生日快乐，Sam！

content.text: Thank you!
content.translation: 谢谢！

content.text: What's the time, please?
content.translation: 请问几点了？

content.text: It's nine o'clock.
content.translation: 九点了。

Module 9.unit: Unit 1 I've got a new book.

content.text: I've got a new book.
content.translation: 我有一本新书。

content.text: It's nice! Can I see it?
content.translation: 真好看！我能看看吗？

content.text: What's wrong, Daming?
content.translation: 大明，怎么了？

content.text: I've got a headache.
content.translation: 我头疼。

content.text: Look at the panda. It's cute.
content.translation: 看那只熊猫。它真可爱。

content.text: It is from China.
content.translation: 它来自中国。

Module 2.unit: Unit 1 This is the way I go to school.

content.text: I go to school on foot.
content.translation: 我走路去上学。

content.text: Today is Sunday. What do you do on Sundays?
content.translation: 今天是星期日。你星期日做什么？

content.text: I often play football.
content.translation: 我经常踢足球。

content.text: Do you like meat?
content.translation: 你喜欢肉吗？

content.text: Yes, I do. But I don't like fish.
content.translation: 是的，我喜欢。但我不喜欢鱼。

Module 5.unit: Unit 1 We fly kites in spring.

content.text: What do you do in spring?
content.translation: 你在春天做什么？

content.text: We fly kites in spring.
content.translation: 我们在春天放风筝。

Module 6.unit: Unit 1 What do you do on Saturdays?

content.text: I watch TV on Saturdays.
content.translation: 我星期六看电视。

Module 7.unit: Unit 1 We have a big family.

content.text: We have a big family.
content.translation: 我们有一个大家庭。

Module 8.unit: Unit 1 We can see the stars.

content.text: We can see the stars at night.
content.translation: 我们晚上能看见星星。

Module 9.unit: Unit 1 I had a good time.

content.text: I had a good time at the party.
content.translation: 我在派对上玩得很开心。

content.text: It's a sunny day today.
content.translation: 今天是晴天。

Module 1.unit: Unit 1 I went to Sanya for my holidays

content.text: Look! These are photos of my holidays.
content.translation: 看！这些是我假期的照片。

content.text: Where did you go, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你去了哪里？

content.text: I went to Sanya with my mother.
content.translation: 我和妈妈去了三亚。

content.text: Sanya is in Hainan. It's very beautiful!
content.translation: 三亚在海南。那里非常美丽！

content.text: Yes! I went swimming in the sea.
content.translation: 是的！我在海里游泳了。

content.text: We had a great time.
content.translation: 我们玩得很开心。

content.text: It was very hot in Sanya.
content.translation: 三亚非常热。

content.text: What did you do there?
content.translation: 你们在那里做了什么？

content.text: We went to the beach. I played on the sand.
content.translation: 我们去了海滩。我在沙子上玩耍。

content.text: And we ate lots of fruit.
content.translation: 而且我们吃了很多水果。

content.text: The mangoes were very sweet!
content.translation: 芒果非常甜！

content.text: Who is this, children?
content.translation: 孩子们，这是谁？

content.text: It's Grandpa!
content.translation: 是爷爷！

content.text: Yes. Grandparents are very special.
content.translation: 是的。祖父母非常特别。

content.text: My grandparents live with us. They are very kind.
content.translation: 我的祖父母和我们住在一起。他们非常和蔼。

content.text: I love my grandparents. They tell me stories.
content.translation: 我爱我的祖父母。他们给我讲故事。

Module 2.unit: Unit 2 I like my grandma best

content.text: I like my grandma best.
content.translation: 我最喜欢我的奶奶。

content.text: Why do you like her?
content.translation: 你为什么喜欢她？

content.text: She makes nice food. And she sings to me.
content.translation: 她做美味的食物。而且她给我唱歌。

content.text: My grandpa plays chess with me.
content.translation: 我的爷爷和我下棋。

content.text: How was your weekend, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你周末过得怎么样？

content.text: It was great! I visited my grandparents.
content.translation: 太棒了！我去看望了我的祖父母。

content.text: What did you do there?
content.translation: 你在那里做了什么？

content.text: We had a big dinner together. My grandma cooked fish.
content.translation: 我们一起吃了丰盛的晚餐。我奶奶做了鱼。

content.text: That sounds wonderful!
content.translation: 听起来太棒了！

Module 3.unit: Unit 2 I went to a farm last Sunday

content.text: Where did you go last Sunday?
content.translation: 上周日你去了哪里？

content.text: I went to a farm with my family.
content.translation: 我和家人去了一个农场。

content.text: What did you see?
content.translation: 你看到了什么？

content.text: I saw many cows and sheep. They were so cute!
content.translation: 我看到了很多奶牛和羊。它们太可爱了！

content.text: Did you ride a horse?
content.translation: 你骑马了吗？

content.text: No, I was a little scared.
content.translation: 没有，我有点害怕。

Module 4.unit: Unit 1 I got a letter from my pen friend

content.text: Do you have a pen friend, children?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们有笔友吗？

content.text: Yes!
content.translation: 是的！

content.text: I got a letter from my pen friend yesterday.
content.translation: 昨天我收到了笔友的来信。

content.text: Where does she live?
content.translation: 她住在哪里？

content.text: She lives in Shanghai. She is a Chinese girl.
content.translation: 她住在上海。她是一个中国女孩。

Module 4.unit: Unit 2 I'm writing to my pen friend

content.text: I'm writing a letter to my pen friend, Tom.
content.translation: 我正在给笔友汤姆写信。

content.text: What are you writing about?
content.translation: 你在写什么内容？

content.text: I'm writing about my school. We have a new library.
content.translation: 我在写我的学校。我们有一个新图书馆。

content.text: That's great! My pen friend also likes reading.
content.translation: 太棒了！我的笔友也喜欢阅读。

content.text: Our school is very beautiful.
content.translation: 我们的学校非常美丽。

content.text: Yes! We have a big playground and a garden.
content.translation: 是的！我们有一个大操场和一个花园。

content.text: And our classroom is bright and clean.
content.translation: 而且我们的教室明亮又干净。

content.text: I love my school. Everyone is very nice here.
content.translation: 我爱我的学校。这里的每个人都很友好。

Module 5.unit: Unit 2 There are many tall buildings

content.text: Look! There are many tall buildings in our school.
content.translation: 看！我们的学校有很多高楼。

content.text: The new building has six floors.
content.translation: 新楼有六层。

content.text: And there is a computer room on the third floor.
content.translation: 三楼有一个计算机教室。

content.text: I like the music room. It's on the second floor.
content.translation: 我喜欢音乐教室。它在二楼。

Module 6.unit: Unit 1 We wish you a Merry Christmas!

content.text: Children, what festival is this?
content.translation: 孩子们，这是什么节日？

content.text: It's Christmas!
content.translation: 圣诞节！

content.text: We wish you a Merry Christmas!
content.translation: 我们祝你圣诞节快乐！

content.text: We have a Christmas tree in our classroom.
content.translation: 我们的教室有一棵圣诞树。

content.text: There are many beautiful lights on the tree.
content.translation: 树上有许多漂亮的彩灯。

content.text: Merry Christmas to everyone!
content.translation: 祝大家圣诞节快乐！

Module 6.unit: Unit 2 I sang some Christmas songs

content.text: What did you do at the Christmas party?
content.translation: 你在圣诞聚会上做了什么？

content.text: I sang some Christmas songs. I danced too!
content.translation: 我唱了一些圣诞歌曲。我也跳舞了！

content.text: I gave presents to my friends.
content.translation: 我给朋友们送了礼物。

content.text: I received a big box of chocolates!
content.translation: 我收到了一大盒巧克力！

Module 7.unit: Unit 1 I'll send you a postcard

content.text: I'm going to Beijing next week.
content.translation: 我下周要去北京。

content.text: How exciting! You'll see the Great Wall!
content.translation: 太令人兴奋了！你会看到长城！

content.text: I'll send you a postcard from Beijing.
content.translation: 我会从北京给你寄一张明信片。

content.text: Thank you! I can't wait to see it.
content.translation: 谢谢！我迫不及待想看到它。

Module 7.unit: Unit 2 I'm going to send a present

content.text: What are you going to do, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你打算做什么？

content.text: I'm going to buy a present for my grandma. It's her birthday.
content.translation: 我要给奶奶买一份礼物。她的生日。

content.text: What will you buy?
content.translation: 你要买什么？

content.text: I'll buy some flowers. She loves flowers.
content.translation: 我要买一些花。她喜欢花。

Module 8.unit: Unit 1 The Pandas are in danger

content.text: Children, do you know the giant panda?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们了解大熊猫吗？

content.text: Yes! They are black and white.
content.translation: 是的！它们是黑白色的。

content.text: The pandas are in danger. There are not many of them.
content.translation: 熊猫处于危险中。它们数量不多。

content.text: We must protect them.
content.translation: 我们必须保护它们。

content.text: We should plant more trees for them.
content.translation: 我们应该为它们种更多的树。

Module 8.unit: Unit 2 There is a small country

content.text: I read a book about China yesterday.
content.translation: 昨天我读了一本关于中国的书。

content.text: China is a big country. There are many mountains.
content.translation: 中国是一个大国。有很多山。

content.text: There is a small country too. It's called Singapore.
content.translation: 也有一个小国家。它叫新加坡。

content.text: Singapore is very small but very beautiful.
content.translation: 新加坡很小但很美丽。

content.text: You look happy today, Lingling. Were you happy yesterday?
content.translation: 玲玲，你今天看起来很开心。你昨天开心吗？

content.text: Yes, I was very happy yesterday. It was my birthday!
content.translation: 是的，我昨天非常开心。是我生日！

content.text: Happy birthday! What did you get?
content.translation: 生日快乐！你收到了什么礼物？

content.text: I got a new bike. It's blue!
content.translation: 我收到了一辆新自行车。它是蓝色的！

content.text: That's wonderful! Can you ride it?
content.translation: 太棒了！你会骑它吗？

content.text: Sam, how was your weekend?
content.translation: 萨姆，你周末过得怎么样？

content.text: I was tired on Saturday. I did a lot of homework.
content.translation: 周六我很累。我做了很多作业。

content.text: I was tired too. I went to a piano lesson.
content.translation: 我也累了。我去上了钢琴课。

content.text: But I was happy! I played with my friends.
content.translation: 但我很开心！我和朋友们玩了。

Module 10.unit: Unit 1 I'm in New York now

content.text: Look, Amy! I'm in New York now!
content.translation: 看，Amy！我现在在纽约！

content.text: Wow! Is it very big?
content.translation: 哇！它很大吗？

content.text: Yes! It's very big and very exciting!
content.translation: 是的！它非常大而且非常令人兴奋！

content.text: What can you see there?
content.translation: 你在那里能看到什么？

content.text: I can see many tall buildings. And the sky is very blue!
content.translation: 我能看到很多高楼。而且天空非常蓝！

content.text: Do you like American food, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你喜欢美国食物吗？

content.text: I like some of it. But I like Chinese food better.
content.translation: 我喜欢一些。但我更喜欢中国食物。

content.text: What's your favourite Chinese food?
content.translation: 你最喜欢什么中国食物？

content.text: I like dumplings and fried rice. They're delicious!
content.translation: 我喜欢饺子和炒饭。它们很美味！

content.text: What are you doing, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你在做什么？

content.text: I'm cleaning my room. It's very dirty!
content.translation: 我在打扫我的房间。它非常脏！

content.text: I'm helping my mum. I'm washing the dishes.
content.translation: 我在帮妈妈。我正在洗碗。

content.text: I'm watering the flowers. They need water.
content.translation: 我在浇花。它们需要水。

content.text: Children, what are you doing now?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们现在在做什么？

content.text: I'm doing my homework.
content.translation: 我在做作业。

content.text: I'm reading a book. It's very interesting.
content.translation: 我在读书。它很有趣。

content.text: I'm writing a letter. I'm telling my grandma about my school.
content.translation: 我在写信。我在告诉奶奶关于我学校的事。

Module 2.unit: Unit 1 It's very hot in summer

content.text: It's very hot in summer.
content.translation: 夏天非常热。

content.text: Yes! I like summer. I can swim in the sea.
content.translation: 是的！我喜欢夏天。我可以在海里游泳。

content.text: I like ice cream in summer. It's very cool!
content.translation: 我喜欢夏天的冰淇淋。它很凉爽！

content.text: But I don't like the hot weather. I stay inside.
content.translation: 但我不喜欢炎热的天气。我待在室内。

Module 2.unit: Unit 2 The sea is very beautiful

content.text: Look at this photo! The sea is very beautiful.
content.translation: 看这张照片！大海非常美丽。

content.text: Where did you go last summer?
content.translation: 你去年夏天去了哪里？

content.text: I went to Hainan with my family.
content.translation: 我和家人去了海南。

content.text: I went to Qingdao. The beaches are wonderful!
content.translation: 我去了青岛。海滩非常棒！

Module 3.unit: Unit 1 What did you do last week?

content.text: Children, what did you do last week?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们上周做了什么？

content.text: I played football on Monday.
content.translation: 周一我踢了足球。

content.text: I read a book on Tuesday. It was about animals.
content.translation: 周二我读了一本书。它是关于动物的。

content.text: I went to the park on Wednesday. I flew a kite.
content.translation: 周三我去了公园。我放了风筝。

Module 3.unit: Unit 2 What did you have last week?

content.text: What did you have for breakfast yesterday?
content.translation: 你昨天早餐吃了什么？

content.text: I had eggs and milk. They were very nice.
content.translation: 我吃了鸡蛋和牛奶。它们很好吃。

content.text: I had bread and juice. What about you?
content.translation: 我吃了面包和果汁。你呢？

content.text: I had noodles. My mum made them.
content.translation: 我吃了面条。我妈妈做的。

content.text: Did you read those books, Amy?
content.translation: Amy，你读了那些书吗？

content.text: Yes, I read them. They were very interesting.
content.translation: 是的，我读了。它们很有趣。

content.text: What did you learn?
content.translation: 你学到了什么？

content.text: I learned about dinosaurs. They lived on Earth a long time ago.
content.translation: 我了解了恐龙。它们很久以前生活在地球上。

content.text: Did you read the science books?
content.translation: 你读了那些科学书吗？

content.text: Not yet. I'll read them tomorrow.
content.translation: 还没有。我明天读。

Module 4.unit: Unit 2 Did you see the film?

content.text: Did you see the film, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你看了那部电影吗？

content.text: Yes! It was very exciting. I liked the music.
content.translation: 是的！它很令人兴奋。我喜欢它的音乐。

content.text: What was it about?
content.translation: 它是关于什么的？

content.text: It was about a little girl and her dog. They went on an adventure.
content.translation: 它是关于一个小女孩和她的狗的。它们进行了一次冒险。

Module 5.unit: Unit 1 I was in the classroom

content.text: Sam, where were you at 9 o'clock yesterday?
content.translation: 萨姆，昨天9点你在哪里？

content.text: I was in the classroom. I was listening to music.
content.translation: 我在教室里。我在听音乐。

content.text: I was in the library. I was reading a book.
content.translation: 我在图书馆里。我在读书。

content.text: I was in the music room. I was singing a song.
content.translation: 我在音乐教室里。我在唱歌。

Module 5.unit: Unit 2 It was a big city

content.text: Where were you last Sunday?
content.translation: 你上周日在哪里？

content.text: I was in Beijing. It was a big city!
content.translation: 我在北京。它是一个大城市！

content.text: Did you visit the Great Wall?
content.translation: 你参观长城了吗？

content.text: Yes! It was very long and very great!
content.translation: 是的！它非常长，非常壮观！

content.text: I was in Shanghai. It was very modern!
content.translation: 我在上海。它非常现代化！

content.text: Children, were you at home last night?
content.translation: 孩子们，昨晚你们在家吗？

content.text: Yes, I was. I watched TV.
content.translation: 是的，我在。我看了电视。

content.text: No, I wasn't. I was at my grandma's house.
content.translation: 不，我不在。我在我奶奶家。

content.text: I was at home. I did my homework and read a book.
content.translation: 我在家。我做了作业，读了一本书。

Module 6.unit: Unit 2 It was a great holiday

content.text: How was your holiday, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你的假期怎么样？

content.text: It was great! I visited Beijing with my family.
content.translation: 太棒了！我和家人一起游览了北京。

content.text: Did you go to Tiananmen Square?
content.translation: 你们去天安门广场了吗？

content.text: Yes! It was very big and beautiful.
content.translation: 是的！它非常大，非常美丽。

Module 7.unit: Unit 1 There is a river near the village

content.text: Where do you live, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你住在哪里？

content.text: I live in a village. There is a river near my house.
content.translation: 我住在一个村子里。我家附近有一条河。

content.text: Is there a mountain?
content.translation: 有一座山吗？

content.text: Yes! There are many mountains near my village.
content.translation: 是的！我家村子附近有很多山。

content.text: That sounds beautiful! Are there any farms?
content.translation: 听起来很美！有农场吗？

content.text: Yes, there are many farms. My uncle has a farm.
content.translation: 是的，有很多农场。我叔叔有一个农场。

Module 7.unit: Unit 2 Is there a lake in the village?

content.text: Is there a lake in your village?
content.translation: 你们村子里有湖吗？

content.text: Yes, there is. There are many fish in the lake.
content.translation: 有的。湖里有很多鱼。

content.text: Are there any trees near the lake?
content.translation: 湖边有树吗？

content.text: Yes, there are many willow trees. They are very pretty.
content.translation: 有的，有很多柳树。它们非常漂亮。

Module 8.unit: Unit 1 What is the weather like?

content.text: Hello! What is the weather like today?
content.translation: 你好！今天天气怎么样？

content.text: It's sunny and warm today. It's a beautiful day.
content.translation: 今天阳光明媚，很暖和。是很美好的一天。

content.text: What's the weather like in winter?
content.translation: 冬天天气怎么样？

content.text: It's cold and snowy. Children can make snowmen.
content.translation: 天气寒冷，还下雪。孩子们可以堆雪人。

Module 8.unit: Unit 2 It's very warm in Hainan

content.text: Is it very cold in Harbin in winter?
content.translation: 哈尔滨冬天很冷吗？

content.text: Yes, it's very cold. It often snows there.
content.translation: 是的，非常冷。那里经常下雪。

content.text: It's very warm in Hainan in winter. People go swimming.
content.translation: 海南冬天非常暖和。人们去游泳。

content.text: China is a big country. The weather is different in different places.
content.translation: 中国是一个大国。不同地方的天气不一样。

Module 9.unit: Unit 1 Are you going to run on sports day?

content.text: Children, are you going to run on Sports Day?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们准备在运动会上去跑步吗？

content.text: Yes, I'm going to run the 100 metres.
content.translation: 是的，我准备跑100米。

content.text: I'm going to jump. I can jump very high.
content.translation: 我准备跳远。我能跳得很高。

content.text: I'm going to swim. I love swimming!
content.translation: 我准备游泳。我喜欢游泳！

Module 9.unit: Unit 2 I'm going to be a driver

content.text: What are you going to be in the future, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你将来想成为什么？

content.text: I'm going to be a driver. I want to drive buses.
content.translation: 我将来要当司机。我想开公共汽车。

content.text: I'm going to be a doctor. I want to help people.
content.translation: 我要当医生。我想帮助人们。

content.text: I'm going to be a teacher. I love children.
content.translation: 我要当老师。我喜欢孩子们。

Module 10.unit: Unit 1 Did you have a nice holiday?

content.text: Children, did you have a nice holiday?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们假期过得愉快吗？

content.text: Yes, I did. I went to the beach with my family.
content.translation: 是的，很愉快。我和家人去了海滩。

content.text: I visited my grandparents. We had a big dinner.
content.translation: 我去看望了祖父母。我们吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐。

content.text: I went to Beijing. I visited many famous places.
content.translation: 我去了北京。我参观了很多著名景点。

Module 10.unit: Unit 2 We had a lovely time

content.text: We had a lovely time during the holiday.
content.translation: 假期期间我们过得很愉快。

content.text: Yes! We took many photos. I want to show them to you.
content.translation: 是的！我们拍了很多照片。我想把它们给你看。

content.text: I wrote a diary every day. It's full of happy memories.
content.translation: 我每天都写日记。里面充满了快乐的回忆。

content.text: The holiday was wonderful! I can't wait for the next one.
content.translation: 假期太棒了！我迫不及待等待下一个假期了。

Module 1.unit: Unit 1 There are only nineteen crayons

content.text: How many crayons are there in the box?
content.translation: 盒子里有多少支蜡笔？

content.text: There are only nineteen crayons. One is missing.
content.translation: 只有十九支。少了一支。

content.text: There are twenty crayons in my box.
content.translation: 我盒子里有二十支蜡笔。

content.text: Let's count together. One, two, three...
content.translation: 我们一起数吧。一，二，三……

content.text: There are nineteen crayons. Who lost one?
content.translation: 有十九支蜡笔。谁少了一支？

Module 1.unit: Unit 2 There are twenty in this box

content.text: How many pencils are there?
content.translation: 有多少支铅笔？

content.text: There are twenty pencils in this box.
content.translation: 这个盒子里有二十支铅笔。

content.text: There are thirty pencils in my box.
content.translation: 我盒子里有三十支铅笔。

content.text: Let's check. One, two, three... Yes, twenty!
content.translation: 我们检查一下。一，二，三……是的，二十支！

content.text: Look! We bought ice creams.
content.translation: 看！我们买了冰淇淋。

content.text: What flavour did you buy?
content.translation: 你买了什么口味的？

content.text: I bought a strawberry ice cream. What about you?
content.translation: 我买了草莓冰淇淋。你呢？

content.text: I bought a chocolate ice cream. It's very sweet.
content.translation: 我买了巧克力冰淇淋。它很甜。

content.text: I bought a vanilla ice cream. I like it very much.
content.translation: 我买了香草冰淇淋。我非常喜欢它。

Module 2.unit: Unit 2 I bought a chocolate ice cream

content.text: Lingling, what did you buy yesterday?
content.translation: 玲玲，你昨天买了什么？

content.text: I bought a new book yesterday. It's about animals.
content.translation: 昨天我买了一本新书。它是关于动物的。

content.text: I bought some crayons. There are twelve colours.
content.translation: 我买了一些蜡笔。有十二种颜色。

content.text: I bought a new bag. It's blue and very pretty.
content.translation: 我买了一个新包。它是蓝色的，很漂亮。

Module 3.unit: Unit 1 My father was a fisherman

content.text: What was your father's job, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你爸爸以前是做什么工作的？

content.text: My father was a fisherman. He caught fish in the sea.
content.translation: 我爸爸以前是渔民。他在海里捕鱼。

content.text: What about your mother?
content.translation: 你妈妈呢？

content.text: My mother was a nurse. She helped sick people.
content.translation: 我妈妈以前是护士。她帮助生病的人。

content.text: My father was a driver. He drove a bus.
content.translation: 我爸爸以前是司机。他开公共汽车。

Module 3.unit: Unit 2 He worked in an office

content.text: What did your uncle do?
content.translation: 你叔叔以前是做什么的？

content.text: He worked in an office. He was a clerk.
content.translation: 他在办公室工作。他是一名职员。

content.text: My aunt was a teacher. She taught English.
content.translation: 我姑姑以前是老师。她教英语。

content.text: My grandfather was a farmer. He grew vegetables.
content.translation: 我爷爷以前是农民。他种蔬菜。

Module 4.unit: Unit 1 We didn't see the Pandas

content.text: Did you see the pandas in the zoo?
content.translation: 你在动物园看到熊猫了吗？

content.text: No, we didn't see the pandas. They were sleeping.
content.translation: 没有，我们没看到熊猫。它们在睡觉。

content.text: Did you see the monkeys?
content.translation: 你们看到猴子了吗？

content.text: Yes! The monkeys were very funny. They jumped around.
content.translation: 是的！猴子非常有趣。它们到处跳。

content.text: I saw the lions. They were very strong.
content.translation: 我看到了狮子。它们非常强壮。

Module 4.unit: Unit 2 The camels were very tall

content.text: What animals did you see in the nature park?
content.translation: 你在自然公园里看到了什么动物？

content.text: I saw some camels. The camels were very tall.
content.translation: 我看到了一些骆驼。骆驼非常高。

content.text: Did you see the tigers?
content.translation: 你看到老虎了吗？

content.text: Yes, I did. The tigers were sleeping under a big tree.
content.translation: 是的，我看到了。老虎在一棵大树下睡觉。

content.text: I saw some elephants. They were drinking water.
content.translation: 我看到了一些大象。它们正在喝水。

Module 5.unit: Unit 1 Dad always puts the rubbish in the bin

content.text: Dad always puts the rubbish in the bin. He is very good.
content.translation: 爸爸总是把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。他非常好。

content.text: My mum always puts the bottles in the bag.
content.translation: 我妈妈总是把瓶子放进袋子里。

content.text: We should put the rubbish in the bin. It's the right thing to do.
content.translation: 我们应该把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。这是正确的做法。

content.text: Yes! Let's keep our city clean.
content.translation: 是的！让我们保持城市整洁。

Module 5.unit: Unit 2 It's the right thing to do

content.text: What should we do to protect the environment?
content.translation: 我们应该做什么来保护环境？

content.text: We should use less plastic. We should plant more trees.
content.translation: 我们应该少用塑料。我们应该多种树。

content.text: We should use less water. We should turn off the lights.
content.translation: 我们应该少用水。我们应该关灯。

content.text: These are all the right things to do.
content.translation: 这些都是正确的做法。

Module 6.unit: Unit 1 I am reading a newspaper

content.text: What are you doing, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你在做什么？

content.text: I am reading a newspaper. There is a lot of news.
content.translation: 我在读报纸。有很多新闻。

content.text: I am reading a magazine. It is about science.
content.translation: 我在读杂志。它是关于科学的。

content.text: Are you reading a book, Mum?
content.translation: 妈妈，你在读书吗？

content.text: Yes, I am. It is a very interesting novel.
content.translation: 是的，我在读。它是一本非常有趣的小说。

Module 6.unit: Unit 2 I am reading an email

content.text: I am reading an email from my pen friend.
content.translation: 我正在读笔友的电子邮件。

content.text: What is she writing about?
content.translation: 她在写什么？

content.text: She is writing about her school life. She likes her English class.
content.translation: 她在写她的学校生活。她喜欢英语课。

content.text: I am writing an email to my uncle. He lives in America.
content.translation: 我正在给叔叔写电子邮件。他住在美国。

Module 7.unit: Unit 1 There are seven in my family

content.text: How many people are there in your family, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你家里有多少人？

content.text: There are seven in my family. My grandparents, my parents, my brother, my sister, and me.
content.translation: 我家有七口人。祖父母、父母、哥哥、姐姐和我。

content.text: That is a big family! Do you all live together?
content.translation: 那是一个大家庭！你们都住在一起吗？

content.text: Yes, we all live together. We are very happy.
content.translation: 是的，我们都住在一起。我们非常幸福。

Module 7.unit: Unit 2 There are four people in my family

content.text: How many people are there in your family, Amy?
content.translation: Amy，你家里有多少人？

content.text: There are four people in my family. My mother, my father, my brother, and me.
content.translation: 我家有四口人。妈妈、爸爸、哥哥和我。

content.text: My family has five people. My grandparents live with us.
content.translation: 我家有五口人。祖父母和我们住在一起。

content.text: In China, many families have grandparents living with them.
content.translation: 在中国，许多家庭都有祖父母和他们住在一起。

content.text: Mum, I'm making a cake. Can you help me?
content.translation: 妈妈，我在做蛋糕。你能帮我吗？

content.text: Of course! First, put the flour in the bowl.
content.translation: 当然！首先，把面粉放进碗里。

content.text: OK! Then what should I do?
content.translation: 好的！然后我应该做什么？

content.text: Now, add the sugar and the eggs. Then mix them together.
content.translation: 现在，加入糖和鸡蛋。然后把它们混合在一起。

content.text: The cake smells delicious! I can't wait to eat it!
content.translation: 蛋糕闻起来好香啊！我迫不及待想吃了！

content.text: What are you doing, Amy?
content.translation: Amy，你在做什么？

content.text: I'm cooking dinner. I'm making some soup.
content.translation: 我在做晚餐。我在煮汤。

content.text: I helped my mum cook dinner yesterday. We made dumplings.
content.translation: 昨天我帮妈妈做晚餐。我们包了饺子。

content.text: I like cooking! I'm going to make a salad today.
content.translation: 我喜欢做饭！今天我准备做沙拉。

content.text: Are you feeling sad, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你感到难过吗？

content.text: No, I'm not. I'm feeling very happy today.
content.translation: 不，我不难过。我今天感到非常开心。

content.text: I'm feeling excited. We are going on a trip tomorrow!
content.translation: 我感到很兴奋。我们明天要去旅行！

content.text: I'm feeling tired. I didn't sleep well last night.
content.translation: 我感到很累。我昨晚没睡好。

content.text: Sam, you should go to bed early tonight.
content.translation: 萨姆，你今晚应该早点睡觉。

content.text: How are you feeling today, children?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们今天感觉怎么样？

content.text: I'm feeling happy. It's a beautiful day!
content.translation: 我感到很开心。今天是美好的一天！

content.text: I'm feeling bored. There's nothing interesting to do.
content.translation: 我感到无聊。没什么有趣的事可做。

content.text: I'm feeling hungry. I didn't have breakfast this morning.
content.translation: 我感到饿了。我今天早上没吃早餐。

content.text: I'm watching TV. There is a good programme on.
content.translation: 我在看电视。有一个好节目。

content.text: What programme are you watching?
content.translation: 你在看什么节目？

content.text: I'm watching a documentary about the ocean. It's very interesting.
content.translation: 我在看一部关于海洋的纪录片。它很有趣。

content.text: I'm playing a computer game. It's about space.
content.translation: 我在玩电脑游戏。它是关于太空的。

Module 10.unit: Unit 2 Are you reading a newspaper?

content.text: Are you reading a newspaper, Dad?
content.translation: 爸爸，你在读报纸吗？

content.text: Yes, I am. There's a lot of news today.
content.translation: 是的，我在读。今天有很多新闻。

content.text: Are you watching TV, Mum?
content.translation: 妈妈，你在看电视吗？

content.text: No, I'm not. I'm listening to music. It's very relaxing.
content.translation: 不，我没有。我在听音乐。它很令人放松。

content.text: I'm reading a book about history. It's very exciting!
content.translation: 我在读一本历史书。它很令人兴奋！

content.text: What's the matter, Lingling? You look pale.
content.translation: 怎么了，玲玲？你看起来脸色苍白。

content.text: I have a headache. I don't feel well.
content.translation: 我头疼。我感觉不舒服。

content.text: You should rest. Did you sleep late last night?
content.translation: 你应该休息。你昨晚睡得很晚吗？

content.text: Yes, I watched TV too late. I didn't sleep enough.
content.translation: 是的，我看电视看到很晚。我睡眠不足。

content.text: You should go to bed early tonight.
content.translation: 你今晚应该早点睡觉。

content.text: What happened, Amy? Are you OK?
content.translation: Amy，发生了什么？你还好吗？

content.text: I fell down from my bike. But I wasn't hurt.
content.translation: 我从自行车上摔下来了。但我没有受伤。

content.text: I'm glad you're OK. You should be more careful.
content.translation: 我很高兴你没事。你应该更小心一点。

content.text: I fell down too. But I wasn't hurt either.
content.translation: 我也摔倒了。但我也没有受伤。

Module 2.unit: Unit 1 Last week, I walked in the park

content.text: What did you do last week, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你上周做了什么？

content.text: Last week, I walked in the park. It was very beautiful.
content.translation: 上周，我在公园散步。它非常美丽。

content.text: I played in the garden. I planted some flowers.
content.translation: 我在花园里玩耍。我种了一些花。

content.text: I went to the library. I read a very interesting book.
content.translation: 我去了图书馆。我读了一本非常有趣的书。

content.text: Sam, were you hungry after school yesterday?
content.translation: 萨姆，昨天放学后你饿了吗？

content.text: Yes, I was very hungry. I ran a lot in PE class.
content.translation: 是的，我非常饿。体育课上我跑了很多。

content.text: Were you thirsty, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你渴了吗？

content.text: Yes, I was! I drank a lot of water.
content.translation: 是的，我渴了！我喝了很多水。

Module 3.unit: Unit 1 We had a nice holiday

content.text: Where did you go on holiday, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你假期去了哪里？

content.text: We went to Hangzhou. We visited the West Lake.
content.translation: 我们去了杭州。我们游览了西湖。

content.text: That sounds great! Did you take photos?
content.translation: 听起来太棒了！你们拍照了吗？

content.text: Yes! I took many photos. The scenery was beautiful.
content.translation: 是的！我拍了很多照片。风景很美。

content.text: We went to Guangzhou. We ate a lot of delicious food.
content.translation: 我们去了广州。我们吃了很多美味的食物。

content.text: The sun is shining. It's a beautiful day.
content.translation: 阳光照耀。今天是美好的一天。

content.text: Yes! The birds are singing. Spring is here.
content.translation: 是的！鸟儿在歌唱。春天来了。

content.text: Look! The flowers are blooming. They are very colourful.
content.translation: 看！花正在开放。它们五颜六色。

content.text: I love spring. Everything is green and beautiful.
content.translation: 我喜欢春天。万物都是绿色的，非常美丽。

content.text: Look at the apple tree! The apples are falling.
content.translation: 看那棵苹果树！苹果在掉下来。

content.text: Let's pick them up. We can make apple juice.
content.translation: 我们来捡吧。我们可以做苹果汁。

content.text: Great idea! I love apple juice.
content.translation: 好主意！我喜欢苹果汁。

content.text: I can see some pears too. They are very big.
content.translation: 我也能看到一些梨。它们非常大。

content.text: Look! The leaves are falling from the trees.
content.translation: 看！叶子从树上落下来。

content.text: It's autumn. The world is full of yellow and red leaves.
content.translation: 现在是秋天。世界充满了黄色和红色的叶子。

content.text: The wind is blowing. The leaves are dancing in the air.
content.translation: 风在吹。叶子和在空中跳舞。

content.text: I like autumn. The weather is cool and comfortable.
content.translation: 我喜欢秋天。天气凉爽舒适。

content.text: Children, happy Children's Day!
content.translation: 孩子们，儿童节快乐！

content.text: Happy Children's Day!
content.translation: 儿童节快乐！

content.text: We have a party today. We are very excited.
content.translation: 今天我们有聚会。我们非常兴奋。

content.text: We have a big cake. It's for all of us.
content.translation: 我们有一个大蛋糕。它是我们所有人的。

content.text: I got many presents. I am very happy.
content.translation: 我收到了很多礼物。我非常开心。

Module 5.unit: Unit 2 There are many children in the park

content.text: There are many children in the park today.
content.translation: 今天公园里有很多孩子。

content.text: Yes! They are playing games. They are laughing and running.
content.translation: 是的！他们在做游戏。他们在笑，在跑。

content.text: I can see some boys playing football. They are very good.
content.translation: 我看到一些男孩在踢足球。他们踢得很好。

content.text: There are some girls dancing. Their dress is very colourful.
content.translation: 有一些女孩在跳舞。她们的裙子五颜六色。

Module 6.unit: Unit 1 There is a river near the school

content.text: Look! There is a river near our school.
content.translation: 看！我们学校附近有一条河。

content.text: Yes! And there are some fish in the river.
content.translation: 是的！而且河里有一些鱼。

content.text: There are also some boats on the river. They are beautiful.
content.translation: 河上也有一些船。它们很漂亮。

content.text: In summer, we can swim in the river.
content.translation: 夏天，我们可以在河里游泳。

Module 6.unit: Unit 2 There are many lakes in China

content.text: Do you know famous lakes in China?
content.translation: 你知道中国有哪些著名的湖吗？

content.text: Yes! There is the West Lake in Hangzhou. It is very beautiful.
content.translation: 是的！杭州有西湖。它非常美丽。

content.text: There is the Dongting Lake in Hunan. It is very big.
content.translation: 湖南有洞庭湖。它非常大。

content.text: There are many beautiful lakes in China.
content.translation: 中国有很多美丽的湖。

content.text: What's the matter, dear? You look tired.
content.translation: 怎么了，亲爱的？你看起来很累。

content.text: I have a headache and a cough. I don't feel well.
content.translation: 我头疼，还咳嗽。我感觉不舒服。

content.text: You should see a doctor. Let me call the doctor.
content.translation: 你应该去看医生。让我打电话给医生。

content.text: Open your mouth and say 'Ah'. You have a cold.
content.translation: 张开嘴说'啊'。你感冒了。

Module 7.unit: Unit 2 My mother is a nurse

content.text: What does your mother do, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你妈妈是做什么工作的？

content.text: My mother is a nurse. She works in a hospital.
content.translation: 我妈妈是一名护士。她在医院工作。

content.text: She helps sick people. That's a great job.
content.translation: 她帮助生病的人。那是一份很棒的工作。

content.text: My father is a doctor. He works in the same hospital.
content.translation: 我爸爸是一名医生。他在同一家医院工作。

content.text: Mum, I'm going to Shanghai next week.
content.translation: 妈妈，我下周要去上海。

content.text: Have a good trip! Who are you going with?
content.translation: 旅途愉快！你和谁一起去？

content.text: I'm going with my parents. We are going to visit relatives.
content.translation: 我和父母一起去。我们要去探亲。

content.text: Are you going by train or by plane?
content.translation: 你坐火车还是坐飞机去？

content.text: We're going by plane. It's faster.
content.translation: 我们坐飞机去。飞机更快。

Module 8.unit: Unit 2 I'm going to visit my grandparents

content.text: What are you going to do in Shanghai?
content.translation: 你准备在上海做什么？

content.text: I'm going to visit my grandparents. They live there.
content.translation: 我要去看望祖父母。他们住在那里。

content.text: Are you going to eat Shanghai food?
content.translation: 你要吃上海菜吗？

content.text: Yes! Shanghai food is very delicious. I'm looking forward to it.
content.translation: 是的！上海菜非常美味。我很期待。

Module 9.unit: Unit 1 I made a model plane

content.text: What did you make at school, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你在学校做了什么？

content.text: I made a model plane. It's blue and white.
content.translation: 我做了一个模型飞机。它是蓝白相间的。

content.text: That's wonderful! Can it fly?
content.translation: 太棒了！它能飞吗？

content.text: Yes! I flew it in the park yesterday. It flew very high.
content.translation: 是的！昨天我在公园放了它。它飞得很高。

content.text: I made a model boat. It can float on the water.
content.translation: 我做了一艘模型船。它能浮在水面上。

Module 9.unit: Unit 2 I ate a big ice cream

content.text: Lingling, did you have a good birthday?
content.translation: 玲玲，你生日过得好吗？

content.text: Yes, I did! I ate a big ice cream cake. It was delicious!
content.translation: 是的，很好！我吃了一个大冰淇淋蛋糕。它很美味！

content.text: I ate a lot of chocolates. My grandma gave me many.
content.translation: 我吃了很多巧克力。奶奶给了我很多。

content.text: I ate some dumplings. My mum made them for me.
content.translation: 我吃了一些饺子。妈妈为我做的。

Module 10.unit: Unit 1 I'm going to be a teacher

content.text: Children, what are you going to be in the future?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们将来想成为什么？

content.text: I'm going to be a teacher. I love teaching children.
content.translation: 我要当老师。我喜欢教孩子们。

content.text: I'm going to be a scientist. I want to discover new things.
content.translation: 我要当科学家。我想发现新事物。

content.text: I'm going to be a teacher too. I want to teach English.
content.translation: 我也要当老师。我想教英语。

Module 10.unit: Unit 2 I'm going to study computer science

content.text: What are you going to study, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你打算学什么？

content.text: I'm going to study computer science. Computers are very important.
content.translation: 我打算学计算机科学。计算机非常重要。

content.text: I'm going to study medicine. I want to help sick people.
content.translation: 我要学医。我想帮助生病的人。

content.text: I'm going to study languages. I want to learn French and Spanish.
content.translation: 我要学语言。我想学法语和西班牙语。
